title: Warm Dense Mexican Little Gem Lettuce Tamales
description: A romantic Veracruzan dish featuring little gem lettuce, reduced and flexitarian-friendly, formed into tamales.
instructions: Soak the corn husks in water for 30 minutes to make them pliable.
In a large bowl, combine the masa harina and vegetable broth to make the tamale dough.
In a skillet, heat the olive oil and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
To the skillet, add the separated little gem lettuce leaves and cook until wilted.
In a bowl, combine the cooked lettuce mixture, crumbled queso fresco, chopped cilantro, lime juice, and salt.
To assemble the tamales, lay a corn husk flat and spread a thin layer of the tamale dough onto the husk.
Place a tablespoon of the lettuce mixture onto the center of the dough.
Fold the sides of the corn husk over the filling and roll the tamale up, then repeat with the remaining ingredients.
Steam the tamales over boiling water for 45 minutes to cook.
